mapper.select: SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, COUNT(rs.route_id) AS routeCount FROM station s LEFT JOIN route_station rs ON s.station_id = rs.station_id GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, s.lng, s.lat

SELECT DISTINCT r.route_id AS routeId, r.route_name AS routeName, r.is_up_or_down AS isUpOrDown FROM route r INNER JOIN route_station rs ON r.route_id = rs.route_id WHERE rs.station_id = #{stationId} ORDER BY r.route_name, r.is_up_or_down
SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat FROM station s INNER JOIN route_station rs ON s.station_id = rs.station_id WHERE rs.route_id = #{routeId} ORDER BY rs.id

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, cnt.parking_count AS parkingCount FROM ( SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS parking_count FROM station_parking GROUP BY station_id ORDER BY parking_count DESC LIMIT #{topN} ) cnt INNER JOIN station s ON s.station_id = cnt.station_id ORDER BY cnt.parking_count DESC

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, sp.start_date_time, sp.end_date_time)) AS avgDurationSeconds, COUNT(*) AS parkingCount FROM station_parking sp INNER JOIN station s ON sp.station_id = s.station_id GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, s.lng, s.lat ORDER BY avgDurationSeconds DESC LIMIT #{topN}
